use_case: Clinical decision support (sepsis prediction) model: scores adult ED and inpatient encounters every 15 minutes and alerts the nurse when the score crosses a threshold, prompting the sepsis screening protocol
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor's predictive decision support intervention (machine learning model supplied with the certified EHR)
build_or_buy: Configure (vendor model; hospital sets scope and alert threshold)
data_categories: Vital signs; laboratory results; nursing assessments; medications; date of birth (age) (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Nurse performs the sepsis screen and calls the provider; the ED physician or hospitalist decides on sepsis treatment; the alert never orders anything
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (Section 1557; input variable age); 45 CFR 170.315(b)(11) (developer duties; source attributes available to the hospital); HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (EHR vendor BAA); FDA device status is the vendor's determination (FD&C Act sec. 520(o)(1)(E) and FDA CDS guidance); CAH QAPI program (42 CFR 485.641)

use_case: Rule-based clinical decision support: weight-based dosing and drug interaction alerts, a nursing early warning score, and the laboratory's eGFR calculation
vendor_or_model: EHR vendor rules engine and laboratory analyzer middleware (non-AI)
data_categories: Age; sex; weight; medications; vital signs; creatinine (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacist and provider accept or override each alert; results reviewed by the provider
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (non-automated tools are in scope under 45 CFR 92.4); inputs include age and sex; confirm the eGFR equation does not use race

use_case: General-purpose generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters and policies

status: Proposed (public tools prohibited for PHI under POL-05 4.8; enterprise tool with a BAA under evaluation)
